# splunkctl alerts

Manage fired alerts and alert actions.

## alerts actions

List available alert action types.

```text
splunkctl alerts actions [OPTIONS]
```

## alerts get

Get every firing of a fired-alert group.

```text
splunkctl alerts get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## alerts list

List fired alerts (one row per firing, with sid for drill-down).

```text
splunkctl alerts list [OPTIONS]
```

```text
--filter matches the rule name; --limit/--offset page the firing rows
client-side (a row is one firing, not one rule).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## alerts suppress

Throttle a rule's alerts by setting alert.suppress on its saved search.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl alerts suppress [OPTIONS] NAME
```

```text
Splunk's fired-alerts endpoint cannot be edited; throttling is a
property of the underlying saved search.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--duration` | integer | 3600 | Throttle window in seconds. |

## alerts unsuppress

Remove alert throttling from a rule's saved search.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl alerts unsuppress [OPTIONS] NAME
```
